purpose: Record the pre-artifact public Neurosetta legacy PCA implementation and its temporal boundary relative to the historical Point_data pickle.

implementation.signature: coord_eig_decomp(coords, robust=True, center=False, PCA=True, sort=True, transpose=True)

relationship_to_historical_point_data.temporal: The implementation predates the December 2025 Point_data artifact.
relationship_to_historical_point_data.compatibility_observation: The public implementation can explain a plausible PCA/eigenvector computational family used before the artifact.
relationship_to_historical_point_data.serialization_boundary: The historical Point_data pickle stores all eight PCA/angle/direction columns as scalar float32 jaxlib._jax.ArrayImpl values; the inspected legacy coord_eig_decomp implementation itself returns NumPy arrays, so this implementation is not by itself proof of the historical producer.
